text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, games we used to play as kids, is it? Let me think~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...! I think I used to play "Horse Ear Look Over There!" with my friends all the time, desu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In between my training sessions, I often played pretend heroes with my friends.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, how lovely. Ardan-chan, what kinds of games did you play when you were little?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Ah, —my apologies. Due to my frail constitution, I spent almost all my time shut inside the manor back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: So I have little experience... with the games everyone else used to play...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —In that case, how about we make those memories together starting right now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let us do it, Ardan-san. Let us play "Pretend Paddock"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: "Pretend Paddock"—that is the game where you roleplay as a fictional horse girl and strike poses, correct?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We also had local house rules. While showing off, one must come to a dead stop the moment "Haaalt!" is called.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall instruct you in the finer details as we play. First, a trial run... Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's start playing "House"♪ All right~, I'll be the mommy~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof-woof!! Please give me some food, wan!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, dinner isn't ready just yet~. Oh, wait, my...? Ardan-chan. You've gotten dirt on your clothes~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, did you go running around outside~? Let's go for a run with Mommy later too, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: —M-Mommy is going to run too?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Next up is a swan boat race for everyone! Ardan-san, you're on my team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: I look forward to it. Though—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: I have little experience with this... How does one make it go faster?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I will teach you everything you need to know! "When two row together, even the sunset shines brighter," after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking a walk... I spotted a group of horse girls looking for something.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...A four-leaf clover is quite elusive indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry. It is all because I mentioned wanting to look for one...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Not at all♪ The fragrance of the flowers is wonderful, and this is such a delightful time~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Why don't we turn it into a competition?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "The Way of the Horse Girl is to compete!" The first one to find one is the winner!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Splendid. I accept the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, honestly, you girls~. ...Come on, you too, Ardan-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes! I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Could this perhaps be...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O & Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, a four-leaf clover! That's a four-leaf clover!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my~. The winner is Ardan-chan, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I did it...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: (For this clover... let's see. I shall preserve it in resin.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: (—As a memento of today. To treasure always.)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: In the end, we couldn't find a clover after all~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Guh, so frustrating! Ardan-san! We definitely have to come back for a rematch next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Fufu... yes. Next time, let's all find one together.
